Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Tsukimichi
Description:
A quest catalog for every journal type, with completed and available filters and a per-requirement breakdown of what still blocks a quest.
Moonlit treasures collects quests with unique rewards, and per-character snapshots keep the whole account in view.
Punchline: Walk the moon's path: every quest, every requirement, every unique reward.
Changelog:
Fixed
- Moonlit no longer lists crystals, Cordials and allied society currencies (Namazu Koban, Hammered Frogment, Loporrit Carat, Yok Huy Ward) as artifact gear: crafter and gatherer society quests pay them through the same per-job reward table the relic and tool lines use, and 568 such rows had slipped in. Only equipment is artifact gear now; the relic weapons and tools are unchanged.
